dataset_name: ATLAS (Anatomical Tracings of Lesions After Stroke) v2.0

segmentation_mask: No (Scan-level reads by three radiologists; bounding boxes later added by the separate BHX dataset)

dataset_name: Ischemic Stroke Lesion Segmentation (ISLES): 2024
institution: University Hospital of the Technical University of Munich, University Hospital of Zurich in Zurich
modality: CT (NCCT, CTA, CTP with perfusion maps), MRI (DWI, ADC)
acquisition_protocol: pretreatment CT, follow-up MR 2-9 days after, CT images were performed on Somatom Force, Somatom Xcite, Somatom AS+, Brilliance 64, and Ingenuity. MR Image was carried out on 3 T Philips, a 3 T Siemens MAGNETOM, or a 1.5 T Siemens MAGNETOM scanners.
segmentation_mask: Yes (Vessel occlusion segmentation in CTA scans: manual/ Ground Truth stroke lesion segmentation on MR images: automated with manual correction/ Segmentation of the Circle of Willis for CTA scans: automated)
preprocessing: Medical imaging exported as NIFTI, anonymized, preprocessed with co-registration,derivation of CTP maps, temporal resampling, and skull stripping. linear/affine registration of CT and MRI scans
clinical_data: Yes (Demographics, patient history, admission NIHSS, 3-month mRS outcome)

dataset_name: Ischemic Stroke Lesion Segmentation (ISLES): 2022
access_type: Open (Training set CC BY 4.0 on Zenodo; test set withheld)
institution: University Hospital of the Technical University of Munich, Inselspital (University Hospital of Bern), University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf
resolution: Voxel sizes varied by center and sequence: FLAIR: [0.23×0.23–1.00×1.00 mm²] in-plane, DWI: [0.57×0.57–2.00×2.00 mm²] in-plane
acquisition_protocol: Scanners: 3T Philips (Achieva, Ingenia), 3T Siemens (Verio), 1.5T Siemens (Avanto, Aera), Sequences: FLAIR, DWI (b=1000), and ADC maps, Reported Parameters: TR, TE, TI, Flip Angle, Voxel size, Slice thickness, and Gap are provided for each sequence and center.
preprocessing: Yes (Data was anonymized, converted to NIFTI, and skull-stripped for de-identification. Released in native space without prior registration.)
staging_information: Yes (Includes hyper-acute (FLAIR-DWI mismatch), acute (0-7 days), and subacute (1-3 weeks) stages.)
